name: Curcumin / Turmeric Extract
tagline: Specification-led turmeric extract route with marker and test method agreed before quotation.
specifications: Curcuminoid marker range and analytical method confirmed against the buyer brief
Extract ratio, carrier status, residual-solvent and physical requirements agreed before sampling
COA and applicable contaminant or microbiological testing scoped to the approved lot
typicalApplications: Food and personal-care applications subject to grade
whyBuyersKnowIt: A widely specified botanical extract whose commercial value depends on marker level, test method and formulation grade.
